cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)

# Oldest macOS the plugin supports (must be set before project()).
set(CMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET "12.0" CACHE STRING "Minimum macOS version")

project(VideoKeyframing VERSION 0.1.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)

if(APPLE)
  enable_language(OBJCXX)
endif()

option(VKF_BUILD_TESTS "Build unit, parity and integration tests" ON)
option(VKF_BUILD_OFX "Build the OpenFX plugin bundle" ON)
option(VKF_ENABLE_METAL "Build the Metal backend (macOS only)" ${APPLE})
option(VKF_ENABLE_VULKAN "Build the Vulkan backend (engine only; OFX has no Vulkan interop)" ON)
option(VKF_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS "Treat compiler warnings as errors" OFF)
option(VKF_BUILD_NODE "Build the Node-API module (vkf.node) for Node/Electron hosts" OFF)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(CMAKE_OBJCXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_OBJCXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
# Plugins must export only the OFX entry points.
set(CMAKE_CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden)
set(CMAKE_OBJCXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden)
set(CMAKE_VISIBILITY_INLINES_HIDDEN ON)

if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE AND NOT CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
  set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release CACHE STRING "Build type" FORCE)
endif()

if(VKF_ENABLE_METAL AND NOT APPLE)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "VKF_ENABLE_METAL requires macOS")
endif()

list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake")
include(VkfWarnings)
include(VkfEmbed)
include(VkfDependencies)

add_subdirectory(core)
add_subdirectory(render)
if(VKF_BUILD_OFX)
  add_subdirectory(ofx)
endif()
if(VKF_BUILD_TESTS)
  enable_testing()
endif()
if(VKF_BUILD_NODE)
  add_subdirectory(bindings/node)
endif()
if(VKF_BUILD_TESTS)
  enable_testing()
  add_subdirectory(tests)
endif()

option(VKF_BUILD_TOOLS "Build developer tools (benchmark)" ON)
if(VKF_BUILD_TOOLS)
  add_executable(vkf_bench tools/vkf_bench.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(vkf_bench PRIVATE vkf::render vkf_warnings)
  if(VKF_ENABLE_METAL)
    target_link_libraries(vkf_bench PRIVATE vkf::render_metal)
  endif()
  if(VKF_ENABLE_VULKAN)
    target_link_libraries(vkf_bench PRIVATE vkf::render_vulkan)
  endif()
endif()
